formula_notes: All 108 P6 fixtures/results are enumerated and SHA-bound; prompt tokens are counted from exact fixture prompt_token_ids.
P8/P6 matching is exact by source_onset, seed, cap and fixture bytes; P8 11 samples are intentionally selected diagnostic rows, not random sample.
Central scenario retains P6 generated-token work and applies observed aggregate matched per-token latency ratio to P6 decode wall; P6 nondecode work is adjusted by median matched nondecode ratio.
Low scenario applies the observed P8/P6 generated-token ratio to full-panel decode work; high scenario allows +20% output work, worst observed matched latency ratio, and +15% nondecode work.
Scenarios are planning sensitivity only. Matched output-length variation is not causal or representative evidence; no P8 full108 run or speed claim.
